headline: "Played Too Much and Got Burned": Why China Switched from Bitcoin to Gold
summary: Reports of record gold purchases by China were linked by a gold producers' union chairman to a drive for financial stability. He described China as having switched from bitcoin to gold.
why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a central-bank reserve asset, and large official or state-linked buying can influence bullion prices.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Record Chinese gold import volumes add to bullion demand, according to the report.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
